title: Verify the Docker image build and compose quick start
description: docker/app.Dockerfile and docker-compose.yml were written at the split; the bundle and the standalone server were smoke-tested, but docker build was not run. Build the image, run docker compose up, check /healthz, open a design, save, and fix whatever breaks.

title: Re-cover the tests dropped at the split on starter data
description: docs/boundaries.md §6 lists every test file dropped because it asserted private designs (editor-react 38 files, studio 19, docs 14, layout 8, render-svg 6, catalog 24, model 17) plus about 270 individual cases removed from kept files. Rebuild coverage for the generic behaviour they exercised (cables list UI, BOM, build sheet, drawing sheet, breakouts, board journey, connector art, cross-sections, structure, wire builder, stock swap, repin, ...) using the starter catalog or small synthetic fixtures.

title: Owner: choose the licence
description: LICENSE is a placeholder (licence TBD, all rights reserved). The owner picks the licence (e.g. Apache-2.0, MPL-2.0, AGPL-3.0, or source-available); then replace LICENSE, add SPDX license fields to every package.json, and check NOTICE compatibility (OFL/GUST fonts, LGPL occt-import-js, CC BY-SA KiCad models only linked).

title: CI pipeline: build, tests, leak scan
description: Add a CI workflow (runner to be chosen by the owner) running pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, pnpm -r build, pnpm test with --maxWorkers=2, and bash scripts/leak-scan.sh on every push.

title: Connector art for the starter families
description: The canvas draws RJ45, XLR, USB-A, JST XH and terminal blocks as generic outlines (layout/src/connector-art.ts covers DIN, mini-DIN, D-sub, HD15, SCART, JP21, RCA, TRS, BNC). Add face drawings from public standard drawings (IEC 60603-7, IEC 61076-2-103, USB-IF, JST datasheet), with citations, and goldens.

title: Wire the module commit hook and auth providers
description: Install registry.commitHook() via setCommitHook in the editor; pass registry.authProviders() into the Better Auth config.

title: Let modules declare catalog files and derived records
description: catalog-version.ts hashes a fixed DIRS list (still includes devices/ and rules/ from the split); let modules declare the data files/dirs they own and their DerivedStore paths, and drop the hard-coded names.

title: Mount module importers and exporters
description: Library: import button offering registry.importersFor(file); proposals reviewed before writing. Documents: list registry.exporters() beside the base documents.

title: Mount module UI panels and routes in the studio SPA
description: Render registry.panels(slot) in the cable inspector, documents, library detail and settings; add /m/<module>/<path> routes and rail entries from registry.routes().

title: Module system: wire every extension point through the app
description: docs/modules.md: the registry exists and PN schemes, validation rules and integration routes are mounted. Still to do: mount UI panels (slots) and UI routes (/m/<id>/), importers in the Library, exporters in Documents, the commit hook from the registry into the editor store, auth providers into Better Auth, module catalog packs at build time, module-declared derived records and API token scopes.

title: Example module package exercising every extension point
description: Add examples/hello-module (a workspace package) contributing a PN scheme, a rule, an importer, an exporter, an integration route, a panel and a UI route; tests run it through the registry and the app; doubles as the template for private modules.

title: Postgres phase D (optional): migrate a file deployment
description: Git history import, shadow sync, parity job, retire the git export in pg mode, cut-over runbook (plan §7.3-7.6).

title: Phase S: self-hosted compose and clean install
description: docker-compose.pg.yml, setup one-shot generating secrets, setup mode and /setup (setup code, org, admin, starter/empty catalog, PN scheme), people/invitations, env guard, restore + restore check, monitoring webhook, upgrade path, studio-api client, clean-install CI job, install docs (plan §8, §9, §11 Phase S).

title: Postgres phase C: worker and jobs
description: pg-boss worker, module import job shape, blob GC, backup job, derive repair, model-cache job (plan §11 Phase C).

title: Postgres phase A: schema and read path
description: Migrations 0000-0013, codec, importer, snapshot, read half of PgStores, pg:gate, test infra, on-demand export (plan §11 Phase A).

title: Postgres phase B: write path, blobs, API clients
description: commitPg, write half of stores, model-link kind on files first (B0), BlobStore fs+S3, PgLockStore, Better Auth on pg with local accounts and invitations, personal API tokens, POST /api/batch and dry runs (plan §11 Phase B).

title: Postgres backend and self-hosted install (plan rev 6)
description: Implement specs/postgres-backend.md rev 6 per specs/postgres-backend-EXECUTION.md: phases A (schema/read path), B (write path, blobs, API tokens, batch/dry-run), C (worker), S (self-hosted compose + clean install), D optional (migration from files), E optional (build/QA).

title: Release image publishing
description: Decide (owner) where release images are published (registry, tags) and add the CI job that builds and pushes them; the self-hosted compose then references the published image.

title: Module hook for bench work instructions
description: packages/docs/src/bench/standard-work.ts now has a small generic step set; let a module supply a shop's own work instructions (per family/termination) through the exporter or a dedicated extension point.

title: Drawing sheet: generic face and cutaway art
description: packages/docs/src/drawing/assets.ts is an empty hook (no traced connector faces, cutaway art or logo). Provide generic traced faces for the starter connectors and a way for a deployment (or module) to supply its own logo and title-block text.

title: Re-specify the drawing language generically
description: The private specs for shield bonding, the schematic SVG, depictions and connector-art review were not ported (full of private examples). Write generic specs from the code and SPEC.md, with starter-catalog examples.

title: Clean leftover private-tracker references from comments
description: Comments still cite bead ids of the private tracker (hdy.N, pci.N, 50a.N, ...) and dated owner remarks; they point nowhere in this repo. Replace with plain explanations or drop them; keep the rule each comment states.

title: Catalog store (docs/catalog-store.md)
description: Implement catalog packs: record fields license/provenance/derivedFrom, pack manifest + verify command, file-backend pack loading and install from file, fork a record, signed static index and Library browse/install/update with diff, first reviewed packs (core-bodies, pro-audio, fieldbus, networking), KiCad model-link pack built reproducibly, publisher keys, review status, yanking. Licence review of sources by the owner before anything is published.
